properties.name: maple.framework.web.client.timeout-seconds
properties.description: Base timeout in seconds. Used as fallback for connect/read/write/response timeouts.

properties.name: maple.framework.web.client.memory-buffer-size-mb
properties.description: Codec max in memory size in MB; also the response Content-Length warning threshold.

properties.name: maple.framework.web.client.acquire-timeout-millis
properties.description: Maximum wait time when acquiring a pooled connection.

properties.name: maple.framework.web.client.pending-acquire-max-count
properties.description: Maximum number of pending acquire requests.

properties.name: maple.framework.web.client.idle-timeout-millis
properties.description: Idle timeout for pooled connections; 0 disables idle eviction.

properties.name: maple.framework.web.client.max-life-time-millis
properties.description: Maximum life time for pooled connections; 0 disables life time eviction.

properties.name: maple.framework.web.client.retry-delay-millis
properties.description: Fixed retry delay in milliseconds; 0 means no backoff.

properties.name: maple.framework.web.client.retry-methods
properties.description: Comma separated HTTP methods eligible for retry; empty disables retry for every method.

properties.name: maple.framework.web.client.user-agent-suffix
properties.description: Optional suffix appended to the fixed User-Agent Maple-Leaf-WebClient/1.0.

properties.name: maple.framework.web.client.connect-timeout-millis
properties.description: Independent connect timeout; falls back to timeout-seconds multiplied by 1000 when unset.

properties.name: maple.framework.web.client.read-timeout-millis
properties.description: Independent read timeout; 0 disables the read timeout (streaming safe). Falls back to timeout-seconds multiplied by 1000 when unset.

properties.name: maple.framework.web.client.write-timeout-millis
properties.description: Independent write timeout; falls back to timeout-seconds multiplied by 1000 when unset.

properties.name: maple.framework.web.client.response-timeout-millis
properties.description: Independent response timeout; 0 disables it. Falls back to timeout-seconds multiplied by 1000 when unset.

properties.name: maple.framework.web.client.lb-guard-enabled
properties.description: Enables the load balancer addressing guard on the load balanced builder. Set to false to restore the legacy behaviour.

properties.name: maple.framework.web.client.lb-guard-allow-hosts
properties.description: Hosts allowed through the load balancer guard, for example dotted service ids such as svc.ns.svc.cluster.local.

properties.name: maple.framework.enable.webclient-lb-guard
properties.description: Unified feature switch for the load balancer addressing guard; takes precedence over maple.framework.web.client.lb-guard-enabled. Defaults to true because the guard closes a misleading synthetic 503 defect (registered constitution IV exemption).
